title: Amazon AGI's Looped Diffusion AI Outperforms AR Baselines
summary:
Amazon AGI has made the code and weights for its Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models (ALoDLM) available through a public repository. The new architecture outperforms all other evaluated diffusion models and autoregressive baselines in average benchmark scores, according to a project page and abstract released by the company.

The release comes after indications that Microsoft's GPT-6 uses looped transformer models. By adopting a looped diffusion approach, Amazon's ALoDLM offers an alternative to the traditional autoregressive methods that have served as the primary standard for large language model development.
